messages:
noah: quick find from a fresh runthrough of the Quickstart: a few small things that trip new users — the curl auth example doesn't show the RW_API_KEY header, Go example still uses legacy client.New("OLD_KEY"), and the 'starter repo' link points to the archived repo. opening a thread to batch fixes.

sophie: can you paste the exact curl line + go snippet? i'll take curl + README copy.

noah: curl currently:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
we should add -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" and show RW_API_KEY env note. go snippet:```go
// old style
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("OLD_KEY"))
res, _ := client.Generate("hello")
```

ravi: i'll update Go to the new SDK shape (redwood.New with options) and show chat example instead of generate. will include a one-line migration note.

katie: i'll run a repo-wide grep for OLD_KEY/REDWOOD_KEY and bad starter links, then open a PR with replacements. i'll also fix the starter repo URL to point to github.com/redwood-inference/starter-apps.

docs-bot: created issue #489: "quickstart: curl auth header, go snippet migration, starter link" assigned to katie/sophie/ravi.

sophie: PR #3201 opened: README copy + curl example updated, added small callout about storing secrets (env/vault) and recommended Docker tip (expose 8080).

ravi: PR #3202 opened: go snippet migrated to SDK v6 style and swapped to chat.create sample. snippet:```go
client := redwood.New(redwood.Config{APIKey: os.Getenv("RW_API_KEY")})
resp, _ := client.Chat.Create(ctx, redwood.ChatParams{Model: "redwood/fast", Messages: []redwood.Message{{Role: "user", Content: "Hey"}}})
fmt.Println(resp.Output)
```

katie: PR #3203 opened: repo sweep for OLD_KEY/REDWOOD_KEY -> RW_API_KEY, link fixes, updated starter-apps reference in examples. also updated two absolute links to relative.

ci-bot: PR #3201 lint OK. PR #3202 unit docs checks needed. PR #3203 link-check found one remaining /old-start URL in examples/starter/README.md.

ravi: fixed the stray link in #3203, pushed.

sophie: quick copy nit: change "store your key securely" to "store your key in environment variables or a secrets manager" in the callout. updated PR.

docs-bot: all PRs now green. PR #3201, #3202, #3203 merged.

deploy-bot: docs site deploy triggered. preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (staging).

noah: verified staging: curl example has Authorization header, Go snippet looks current, starter-apps link resolves. thanks all. resolving thread. :white_check_mark:
